wins: Mapped open service ports (22, 80, 443) quickly, providing a solid attack surface within one episode
Captured detailed service banners that informed subsequent scripting and enumeration choices
fails: No successful pivot or privilege escalation; root flags remained unreachable after exploit attempts
Excessive mentor call usage (15) indicates reliance on external guidance rather than automated decision chains
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance phase but inability to translate findings into reliable exploitation kept success rate at 0%; focus next on automated attack chaining.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication gating on admin endpoints (SSH+HTTP) blocked exploits, repeatedly failing after banner enumeration when default creds were rejected

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap ssh-* scripts and note available ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes predictable admin paths (e.g., /admin, /manager)
skill_cards.then_action: Launch Gobuster/Dirsearch with tuned wordlists followed by targeted POST requests on discovered forms

skill_cards.if_condition: When SUID binaries or weak sudo policies are detected on Linux hosts
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize local exploit chaining (e.g., GTFOBins) before more complex privilege escalation scripts
